exam.reading:
Text 1: Use plain language and short sentences instead of jargon.

Text 2: Translation review improves language access in a multilingual notice.

Text 3: Seek clarification from a qualified professional about the scope of advice.

Text 4: A comprehension check uses teach-back to compare understanding with intended meaning.

questions.prompt: Track 1: Cụm “intended reader” được dùng với nghĩa nào?

questions.explanation: superseded = đã bị thay thế. Ngữ cảnh: Add a review date so superseded content does not appear as current information.
